task.description: Implement REQ-519 PR 2e-a (enforced-tenant writers). Mandatory SEC: role_registry.ex, scoped writers, ScopeEnforcement.

result.summary: 2e-a built per design r2a: ScopeEnforcement.mode_under_lock!/1 (raises ModeUnavailableError in production; lenient :off only behind test-only key, built because role_scope_grants_backfill_test T-B7 truly needs it), reconcile_binding!/3 result type and mode-aware low-level writers, refusal + binding.refused (BindingRefusal), NO-ROW report siblings, seeding NO-ROW with audit key rows=skipped_enforced, TAM skip for on, Backfill skip for on (dry run reads get_mode/1), HTTP 409 scope_required, BindingWriters registry. NOT done: the registry completeness scan test and all new tests (TEST-DESIGNER), the mix-task run in 2e-b items (sync suppression, scope_delta, membership_rows).

Only malformed prefix and absent tenants row are lenient; a failed read always raises. The scan/prod-config evaluation test for the key is TEST-DESIGNER's.
BindingWriters has binding_rows/0 and entry_points/0 only; membership_rows/0 is 2e-b. Scan test not written (new test).
ensure_tenant_wide_group_row!/3 now raises ArgumentError outside a transaction (via ensure_in_transaction!), previously it did not check.
No new public function on RoleScopeGrants; route walk test (exports pin) passes.
TAM dry run reads the mode with get_mode/1 and reports a skipped_enforced tenant for an on tenant.
